title: Entry Point and Program Structure
description:
## Program Structure
All programs in C have a entry point. All statements in C end with a ;. Note that `#include` and `int main() {}` are not statements.
## The Entry Point
The Entry Point is where your program starts. In C, that is the `main` function. Functions are a later concept, but just remember that the main function is this:
```c
int main() {
    // Code goes here
    return 0;
}
```
Note that preproccessers (lines starting in #) don't go in main.
